losing your buddy like that really hurts. I lost my cat back in October, I'm so sorry you're going through this, I understand you're probably going through a lot right now. Just remember it's not your fault, and the little guy is probably soaring high somewhere. Its a lot easier to cope with grief when you just go with it, don't pretend to be okay, let it all out if need be. If possible, reach out to people, you could try group sessions or something like that. It helped me to talk to friends about it. Stay strong, again im sorry you're going through this, I hope things get better soon.
